name: Miami Custom Wood & Design LLC
address: 13070 SW 248th St, Homestead, FL 33032, United States

reviewSamples.author: Eduardo Palacio
reviewSamples.text: Miami Custom Wood does an amazing job! They do incredible work and can bring any idea you have to life. Whatever you imagine, they can make it happen! Great quality, excellent attention to detail, and very professional service. Highly recommended! You won't be disappointed!

reviewSamples.author: Stephanie C
reviewSamples.text: Amazing work and excellent quality! Very professional and reliable. I'm really happy with the result and would definitely recommend them!

reviewSamples.author: Fernandez Bertolero
reviewSamples.text: Victor helped us design and build our living room bookshelf.. we are so happy with the end product. He was super professional. Highly recommended

reviewSamples.author: Tahin C
reviewSamples.text: Excellent service and beautiful work would recommend 100%

reviewSamples.author: Frank Acevedo
reviewSamples.text: Professionalism and impeccable service. What I appreciate most about Miami Custom Wood & Design is the trust they inspire. The owner, Victor, is a very kind, polite, and responsible person. He was very attentive to every detail of our design and exceeded our expectations. The quality of the wood and the precision of the installation demonstrate his excellent work. I will definitely hire them again for future projects. Thank you so much for the great service!

research_notes: No se encontro Instagram, Facebook ni email publico tras busqueda web (WebSearch con variaciones de nombre, telefono y dominio). Negocio sin presencia digital propia mas alla de su ficha de Google Maps. Google Business confirma: sin boton de website (solo 'Add website'), categoria 'Cabinet maker', atributos women-owned y Latino-owned. 10 fotos propias (prefijo gps-cs-s, subidas por el negocio) descargadas via contact sheet de Google Maps; se descarto 1 avatar de reseña (prefijo a-/ALV) y 1 foto redundante (gmaps-6, TV console generico) para la seleccion final de galeria.
